name: Gordon's Crate
summary: Weapons are bound for the Forsaken forces in Silverpine Forest, packed in Gordon's Crate in the Undercity. The shipment is meant for the remote garrison at the Sepulcher.

sections.title: Supplies for Silverpine
sections.body: The Forsaken keep a steady flow of supplies from the Undercity to hold Silverpine Forest. Gordon's Crate carries weapons for Deathguard Podrig's defenders at the Sepulcher. The outpost sentries face worgen, wild beasts, and human remnants in the woods.

sections.title: The Bat Handler's Route
sections.body: Overland roads from the capital are dangerous and slow, so valuable shipments travel with the Undercity's bat handlers. Gordon's Crate is handed to Michael Garrett, the bat master above the city's trade quarter. He arranges passage on a trained flying bat to Karos Razok's roost back at the Sepulcher.

faq.answer: Gordon's Crate holds weapons and vital combat supplies requisitioned from the Undercity to reinforce Deathguard sentries in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive Gordon's Crate?
faq.answer: Deathguard Podrig at the Sepulcher is meant to receive Gordon's Crate. Michael Garrett, an Undercity bat handler, arranges its flight.

faq.q: Why is the crate transported by bat instead of a courier on foot?
faq.answer: Silverpine Forest remains contested and hazardous. Trained bats overseen by Michael Garrett and Karos Razok carry shipments swiftly through the air, away from threats along the ground routes.

faq.q: Why does Michael Garrett require you to visit the Sepulcher first?
faq.answer: Forsaken bats instinctively return to the capital. Before they can safely fly to an outlying base like the Sepulcher, you must first establish a connection with its local handler, Karos Razok.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know every shipment of blades and gear from the capital helps hold Lady Sylvanas's tenuous frontier borders in Silverpine Forest.
As a member of the Horde, you see the Forsaken's flight routes bringing supplies and couriers swiftly across contested Lordaeron.
